baseline.source:
(defpackage #:mcclim-composite-flipping-probe (:use #:clim #:clim-lisp))
(in-package #:mcclim-composite-flipping-probe)
(let* ((surface (mcclim-browser::host-call "createSurface" 24 24))
       (medium (make-instance 'mcclim-browser:browser-medium :port (find-port :server-path '(:browser))))
       (red (make-rgb-color 1 0 0)) (blue (make-rgb-color 0 0 1))
       (flip (make-flipping-ink red blue))
       (box (make-rectangle* 4 4 12 12)))
  (setf (climi::medium-drawable medium) surface)
  (flet ((probe (label ink)
           (handler-case
               (progn
                 (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 24 24 :filled t :ink red)
                 (draw-rectangle* medium 0 0 24 24 :filled t :ink ink)
                 (list label :drawn))
             (error (condition) (list label (princ-to-string condition))))))
    (list (probe :over (compose-over flip red))
          (probe :in (compose-in flip box))
          (probe :out (compose-out flip box))
          (probe :stencil (compose-in red flip)))))
